### Review assessment

The reviewed catalog/discovery and host integration did not leave an established actionable defect. The assessment covered incomplete-scan retention, aliases and visibility, saved pins/history, query growth and provider reloads. The subsequent PR-stack proposal has been accepted in the maintainer discussion; it is not an outstanding request to redesign this PR or an author-wait condition.

**Validation scope:** The retained affected-input-equivalence checks support the x64 CI results for Apps (871), UI (776) and ViewModels (1,228; one skipped). They do not prove whole-tree identity or interactive, accessibility, localization or performance sign-off. The accumulated review is qualified, not a fresh whole-PR clean-review claim or unconditional approval.
